title: Forced full reindex shares the 60s spawnSync timeout on a 2804-file corpus: if `index --force` exceeds 60s it is killed, the .indexed-head stamp is never written, and every subsequent call re-attempts the same 60s reindex forever (permanent per-call penalty, DB silently stale)
telemetry: C.1 recorded 9.0s cold index for a ~33-file fixture (windows-platform.md); this repo's corpus_signature reports file_count 2804. Index time scaling on the full repo is unmeasured - that is the investigation.
observe_how: Trigger the force path (delete .codegraph/.indexed-head, ensure a delete/rename in the worktree so headMoved && hasStructural) and time `index --force` on this repo. If >60s: syncWholeProject returns false, writeIndexedHead never runs, and ensureFresh re-enters the same branch on the next call - an unbounded retry loop invisible to telemetry (D4b-08: freshness provenance is never emitted, so duration_ms cannot be decomposed). Mitigation options: longer timeout for the force path, or write a 'force failed at <head>' tombstone to back off.

title: compiler-in-the-loop.ts and typescript-preflight.ts interpolate the edited file_path into a cmd.exe shell string with only double-quote wrapping (no metachar escaping) — a NEW unescaped-interpolation site class D5a did not cover
causal_links: same shell-string interpolation class as D5a-01/02/03 (store-side), but the untrusted token here is the EDITED file_path not agent/user free text
observe_how: Both build a shell command string by interpolating the tool_input file_path with ONLY surrounding double-quotes and zero metachar escaping, then execSync it (cmd.exe on Windows). compiler-in-the-loop.ts:82 `lean "${filePath}" 2>&1`; typescript-preflight.ts:90 `python3 "${scriptPath}" --file "${filePath}" --json`. A file_path containing a `"`, `&`, `|` or `$()` breaks the quoting and runs as a subcommand. Lower than D5a because the source is the path Claude just edited (Claude-controlled, not an external attacker) and the surfaces are niche (.lean edits; typescript-preflight additionally calls `python3`, which does not exist on Windows per windows-platform.md, so it never fires here). Payoff: switch to spawnSync('lean'/'python', [..., filePath], {shell:false}) — array args remove the entire interpolation class (the same fix D5a prescribes for the store-side sites and the codegraph platform contract already mandates for spawning binaries).
telemetry: Add a one-line canary: log when filePath passed to runLeanCompiler/main contains any of " & | ; $ ` ( ) before execSync; count non-zero exits.
